note: Synthetic tool names for the test suite; not a real Bitbucket MCP server. The seam refuses this profile unless ASDLC_ALLOW_TEST_BB_PROFILE=1. To add a real one, copy it to bitbucket-<name>.json (without the test flag), set the server's tool names, argument names and response paths, and set ASDLC_BB_MCP_SERVER (and ASDLC_BB_MCP_PROFILE if the profile name differs) in your shell environment.
